parts.label: (b)
parts.question_text:
The circuit shown in Fig. 5.1 contains a battery of electromotive force (e.m.f.) E and negligible
internal resistance connected to four resistors R_{1}, R_{2}, R_{3} and R_{4}, each of resistance R.
The current in R_{3} is 0.30 A and the potential difference (p.d.) across R_{4} is 2.4 V.
parts.question_text_latex:
The circuit shown in Fig. 5.1 contains a battery of electromotive force (e.m.f.) E and negligible
internal resistance connected to four resistors $R_{1}$, $R_{2}$, $R_{3}$ and $R_{4}$, each of resistance R.
The current in $R_{3}$ is 0.30 A and the potential difference (p.d.) across $R_{4}$ is 2.4 V.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.question_text: Show that R is equal to 4.0 Ω.

parts.question_text:
Determine the e.m.f. E of the battery.
E = V

parts.label: (c)
parts.question_text:
The battery in (b) is replaced with another battery of the same e.m.f. E but with an internal
resistance that is not negligible.
State and explain the change, if any, in the total power produced by the battery.

parts.label: (d)
parts.question_text:
The resistors in the circuit of Fig. 5.1 are made from nichrome wire of uniform radius 240 μm.
The length of this wire needed to make each resistor is 0.67 m.
Calculate the resistivity of nichrome.
resistivity = Ω m
